sources: dossier=Net position L11 + Required behaviors L25 + Intentional absences L41 (2026-06-20, 8a3b8c19, transcript: intra-subgraph cascade continues during hold, corrected from the sketch's blanket-defer rule); doc=auto-terminal.md:14 said running→held 'does NOT fire the cascade walker'; code=runner_terminal.go:207-231 fires emitSignalInTxWithFilter with a member-only heldFilter at the held transition.

sources: dossier=auto-terminal.md Required behaviors L32 (2026-06-06, comprehensive-gap-closure, artifact-only: classed producer verb errors route into error_types, never tx-fatal) and L30 (2026-06-22, 10cf843b, transcript: give_up + poison is the uniform path, no retry); doc=auto-terminal.md was silent on the verb-error branch; code=auto_terminal.go:117-123 + routeHeldClaimVerbError:131-162 promotes to abandoned on classified error, no retry, no successful verb call.

Doc previously implied every resolution requires a successful verb; added a sentence documenting the error branch.

sources: dossier=Net position L10 (2026-06-20, option B, transcript: held is derived from participation in ANY unresolved claim handle) and L12 + Required behaviors L27 (2026-06-21, 10cf843b, transcript: poison rule with forward propagation, holder leaves held only when its full claim portfolio is resolved); doc=auto-terminal.md:34/16 stated held→fresh/held→failed per-holder transitions unconditionally; code=held_cascade_defer.go:247-320 transitionHolderIfFullyResolved gates on evaluateHolderPortfolio.FullyResolved and chooses failed whenever the portfolio contains any abandoned handle.
note: Dossier's derived-held definition directly implies portfolio gating: a holder in another unresolved handle stays held, and any co-participation in an abandoned handle poisons it to failed even at this handle's Commit. Doc's per-holder transition bullets were unconditional. Added the portfolio-gating qualifiers to the Commit/Abandon bullets and the invariant.

sources: dossier=Required behaviors L28 (2026-06-21, 10cf843b, transcript: 'Deferred Commit/Abandon cascade fires only to non-members of the holding subgraph; members coordinate via the held state transition and get no downstream cascade'); doc=auto-terminal.md:34 unqualified 'Downstream subscribers never observe a held node-run's terminal before this moment'; code=runner_terminal.go:211-231 emits terminal/success to holding-subgraph members via subgraphMemberFilter at the running→held transition, before resolution.

sources: dossier=Required behaviors L25/L28 + Corrections L51 (2026-06-20/21, transcript: intra-subgraph cascade continues during hold; members receive each sibling's held-transition cascade, and only the deferred resolution-triggered cascade is withheld from them); doc=auto-terminal.md:40 'they do not also receive a downstream cascade from a sibling member's terminal' read as members receiving no sibling cascade at all; code=runner_terminal.go:211-226 (member cascade at held time) vs held_cascade_defer.go:299 (subgraphNonMemberFilter on the resolution walk only).
note: The sentence conflated two distinct cascades (the immediate member-filtered held-transition cascade, which members DO receive, and the deferred resolution cascade, which they don't) into one ambiguous denial. Reworded to specify members already received the held-transition cascade and are withheld only the second, resolution-triggered one.
